acceptance: unchanged native windows,14 public,105 history. Critical unknown rejects.
independent: Only after ALL four terminal versions freeze, and at least one new native accepted version. One fresh56-scenario batch for all final hashes, no feedback, equal hashes replayed once with mapping.
stop: Transport or execution exception stops all remaining calls. Normal rejection stops its arm. No accepted+independent-pass version means pilot fails and stops; no new prompt/call budget automatically.
continuation: Never start seed7919 here, even after pilot pass. Report eligibility only; separate execution and authorization required.
protected: Prior independent inputs used only for exclusion, old artifacts unchanged.

parent_design.objective: Disentangle sample presentation and feedback repetition without changing acceptance; not a test of the two core innovations.
parent_design.controls: Same RTL,11 full public samples, actual failed plan/diagnostics, whole-plan gate, native windows,14 public and105 history. Compact arm losslessly references duplicate samples/labels, does not remove evidence. Binding IDs encode input only, no legal/buggy label.

budget.actual_input_tokens: Report service usage; no exact tokenizer available, do not pretend equal token costs.

parent_design.pilot: Complete all four arms of seed7907; if no arm produces a new native accepted version with the prescribed new independent pass, stop. Only then run seed7919. Report pilot and conditional continuation separately, not unbiased pooled replication.
stops: Any transport error: stop all subsequent calls, preserve usage uncertainty.
Schema, rule/window or native failure: stop that arm; no extra repair call.
All arms use own entire response; never merge successful fields, hand repair, or fill missing labels.
No accepted pilot: stop, report failure and do not open another prompt-only continuation automatically.
If expanding shared-reference feedback changes reconstructed information, do not call model.
Independent failures never feed back. Any later use promotes the whole related test batch to development.
parent_design.final_acceptance: Unchanged complete-plan pass, native trigger/target checks,14 public and105 history; critical unknown rejects; durable previous version preserved; freeze then new unseen test with actual five-obligation exposure.
parent_design.comparisons: B-A and D-C identify binding presentation; C-A and D-B identify lossless feedback compression. Seeds are not guaranteed deterministic; two seeds are exploratory. Primary endpoints complete-plan pass, actual native accepted version and independent pass, not field accuracy alone.
parent_design.gate_benefit: Not causally identified by this design: every arm keeps the gate. Track rejected error types, downstream success and cost; do not claim necessity or superiority of the plan gate.
parent_design.infrastructure: Execution/authorization controller for this factorial protocol NOT implemented here. Before any run, enforce budgets, isolation and final freeze with local tests. Request previews are not runnable approval or completion.
parent_design.disclosure: All11 examples and previous failures are observed development data. Neither the render experiment nor its candidate selection is independent validation of a new bug.

scope: One observed development task, four presentation arms. Not the two core mechanism ablation; no causal gate/no-gate comparison.
